entities.name: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the network to the UE to request activation of a dedicated EPS bearer context associated with the same PDN address(es) and APN as an already active default EPS bearer context.

entities.name: Protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol type. Mandatory field in the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifies the EPS bearer. Mandatory field in the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

entities.name: Procedure transaction identity
entities.description: Identifies the procedure transaction. Mandatory field in the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

entities.name: Linked EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifies the linked EPS bearer. Mandatory field in the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

entities.name: EPS QoS
entities.description: Specifies the EPS quality of service parameters. Mandatory field in the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

entities.name: TFT
entities.description: Traffic flow template defining packet filters for the bearer. Mandatory field in the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

entities.name: Transaction identifier
entities.description: Optional information element for transaction identification in the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

entities.name: Negotiated QoS
entities.description: Optional information element specifying negotiated quality of service parameters in the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

entities.name: Protocol configuration options
entities.description: Optional information element for protocol configuration in the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: Optional information element for extended protocol configuration in the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

relations.description: The ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains the Protocol discriminator IE.
The ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains the EPS bearer identity IE.
The ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains the Procedure transaction identity IE.
The ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains the Linked EPS bearer identity IE.
The ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains the EPS QoS IE.
The ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains the TFT IE.
The ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message optionally contains the Transaction identifier IE.
The ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message optionally contains the Negotiated QoS IE.
The ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message optionally contains the Protocol configuration options IE.
The ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message optionally contains the Extended protocol configuration options IE.
